This interaction may lead to a downstream effect on SW684, as Azadirachtin Q is reported to target SW684. The evidence is consistent with a mechanism where 1,3-Dicyclopentylcyclopentane may act as a modulator or activator of Azadirachtin Q, which in turn affects SW684 through its interaction with calcium channels. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role for 1,3-Dicyclopentylcyclopentane in influencing SW684 via a complex network of molecular interactions involving Azadirachtin Q and calcium channel activity.
